meta.description: Registry for bounded epsilon-null threshold stability conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

epsilon_null_stability_entries.name: Epsilon-Null Stability
epsilon_null_stability_entries.purpose: Represent bounded admissibility-boundary and epsilon-null threshold behavior across recursive continuation structures.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: epsilon_null_boundary_detectable
epsilon_null_conditions.description: The system must possess formal predicates to identify proximity to the epsilon_null threshold.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: threshold_bifurcation_remains_bounded
epsilon_null_conditions.description: Bifurcations triggered at the threshold must not result in unbounded state divergence.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: window_boundary_instability_detectable
epsilon_null_conditions.description: Instability arising from window drift near the threshold must be formally trackable.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: continuation_updates_near_threshold_remain_admissible
epsilon_null_conditions.description: Admissibility must be maintained even as process mismatch approach the null boundary.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: exact_null_collapse_not_required
epsilon_null_conditions.description: The framework does not assume the existence of an exact zero-epsilon state for stability.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: recursive_threshold_drift_remains_bounded
epsilon_null_conditions.description: Drift in the threshold value itself under recursion must stay within finite limits.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: branch_pruning_near_threshold_preserves_required_witness
epsilon_null_conditions.description: Aggressive pruning at the boundary must not eliminate all admissible continuations.

epsilon_null_conditions.name: threshold_instability_does_not_force_global_breakdown
epsilon_null_conditions.description: Localized boundary failures do not imply the collapse of the entire continuation structure.
